# Vendor directory

Clone the Colanode monorepo here at the pinned tag (see `COLANODE_VERSION`):

```bash
git clone --depth 1 --branch v0.4.7 https://github.com/colanode/colanode.git colanode
cd colanode
npm install --ignore-scripts --engine-strict=false
```

The `colanode/` tree is gitignored; do not commit it.
